delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party receiving confidential information shall use it solely to evaluate the potential transaction, protect it with reasonable care, and disclose it only to representatives who need to know it for that purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. Each receiving party’s confidentiality obligations continue for three years after its receipt of the applicable confidential information. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
